title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Can’t believe you didn’t let it out last night
You celebrated with me while I kept you from being by yourself on a Holiday evening.
Congrats..how long? Are you re-upping Gardy too
I have your cigar case. Not going to disclose how long, maybe at a later date I will let you know. Just got this. So I’m going to wait on All staff until some point after the Trade deadline
Did you sign it already or agree to it
Keep to yourself for now. I agreed have not had time to sign the contract yet.
Press conference is at 3, if I can put out sooner that you agreed (no quotes), let me know
When did everything go down? Weekend? Yesterday?
He brought it up in Spring Training and we agreed to follow up sometime after the season starts. We had some time this week and it came together quickly
Liked “He brought it up in Spring Training and we agreed to follow up sometime after the season starts. We had some time this week and it came together quickly ”
